description: Compute permutations P(n,r) and combinations C(n,r) for any n up to 1000. See the formula and the exact count instantly.

faqs.q: What is the difference between permutations and combinations?
faqs.a: Permutations count arrangements where order matters (electing a president, then a vice-president). Combinations count selections where order does not matter (choosing a committee). So P(n,r) is always ≥ C(n,r).
P(n,r) = n! / (n−r)! and C(n,r) = n! / (r! × (n−r)!). This calculator evaluates them with a multiplicative loop that avoids computing huge factorials directly.

faqs.q: What does r have to satisfy?
faqs.a: r must be a whole number with 0 ≤ r ≤ n — you cannot choose more items than exist.

howto: Enter n, the total number of items.
Enter r, how many items are picked.
Choose Permutation P(n,r) (order matters) or Combination C(n,r) (order does not matter).
Read the exact count together with the formula used.
title: Permutation & Combination Calculator
